column1: # Exact EPathMap map meet: topology reconstruction versus synchronized zipper intersection.
# Experiment checkpoint: b7a58c177. Selected production checkpoint: b193ea746.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned.
# Preflight: 87.78% aggregate idle; CPU 8 was 99.00% idle; 52 GiB available memory; zero swap used.
# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 /usr/bin/time -v cargo bench -j4 -p models --bench epathmap_map_meet_zipper --features epathmap-meet-differential
# Design: 60 retained paired/interleaved samples after 10 warmups per cell; arm order rotated each repetition; exactly one run.

# Fixture: 2,048 nominal entries per operand; disjoint 64B/4096B roots, half overlap, independent equality, 128-byte shared prefix, sparse associations over common topology, common value-free topology, early conflict, and late conflict.
# Correctness: exact EntryTrie result or exact first ValueConflict and ACTree03 topology asserted before timing.
# Result: ACCEPTED by pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 255. Welch t=-8.2763288977, p=1.9159789007e-16, Cohen's d=-0.5036813367, 95% CI [-659692.9415,-406831.3252] ns.
# Robustness: Cliff's delta=-0.4074074074; Mann-Whitney p=0.0. Both arms are non-normal, and the nonparametric result agrees.
# Decision: synchronized zipper intersection is the sole production map-mode meet; all nine cells improve and no 3% per-cell regression guard activates.

# Benchmark warning disposition: ratio-consistency warnings in very small treatment cells change the preferred effect-size estimate to paired deltas/medians; they do not change direction, paired-interval exclusion, or the no-regression result. The one-run protocol was not rerun.
# Resources: 106,052 KiB peak RSS; 1.84 s wall time; 8,192 MiB MemoryMax; zero swap.
